title.narrative: Stabilisation as multisectoral response to displaced youth and women in Central Mali ( Bandiagara)

description.narrative: In order to respond to the internal displacement crisis in Central Mali, UNDP intends to consolidate the gains made through the Liptako-Gourma Stabilisation Facility (LGSF). UNDP’s stabilization program aims at improving the social contract between the State and communities, laying the foundations for longer-term peace and development programmes. This project aims at leveraging stabilization as a multisectoral response to internally displaced women and youth. The overall objective of this project is to support stabilization efforts with a focus on recovery and resilience processes for women, female, male youth, and girls recently affected by internal displacement and gender-based violence through an integrated gender-responsive socio-economic and livelihood opportunities in host communities in Bandiagara.
